venues.name: Copper Ladle Breakfast Club
venues.description: A morning table built around the sound of akara batter meeting hot oil. Breakfast runs from pap and fritters to stacks of soft banana pancakes.

items.name: Akara & Pap
items.description: Black-eyed peas are beaten into a light batter and fried until crisp. A bowl of smooth pap sits alongside for dipping.

items.name: Banana Griddle Cakes
items.description: Ripe banana folded into a soft griddle cake, served in a stack with a trickle of syrup.

items.name: Peppered Plantain Cups
items.description: Little cups of golden plantain cradle a finely chopped tomato and pepper filling.

items.name: Tomato & Egg Skillet
items.description: Soft egg curds fold into onions and tomatoes cooked down until sweet, with a little fresh chilli.

items.name: Cumin Chicken Wings
items.description: Charred wings tossed with toasted cumin, crushed garlic and a squeeze of lemon.

items.name: Ginger Lime Iced Tea
items.description: A long glass of ginger-steeped tea, served over ice with a squeeze of lime.

venues.name: Tamarind Soi
venues.description: The rhythm of the wok sets the pace at this small noodle kitchen. Tamarind, lime and fresh herbs cut through the smoky edges of each plate.

items.name: Tamarind Prawn Pad Thai
items.description: Rice noodles turn in a hot wok with prawns, egg and tamarind. A wedge of lime brightens the last bite.

items.name: Basil Drunken Noodles
items.description: Broad rice noodles catch at the edges in the wok before a final toss with chilli and fragrant basil.

items.name: Tom Kha Gai
items.description: Galangal and lemongrass steep in coconut broth with tender chicken and a squeeze of lime.

items.name: Green Chicken Curry
items.description: Green chilli paste blooms in coconut cream before chicken and basil join the pan.

items.name: Lime-Steamed Fish
items.description: Gently steamed fish takes a bright dressing of lime juice, garlic and fresh chilli.

items.name: Crisp Thai Chicken Cakes
items.description: Small, golden chicken cakes with a springy centre and sweet chilli sauce on the side.

venues.name: Red Pepper Courtyard
venues.description: A Sichuan menu that moves between warming chilli oil and cooling cucumber. Bowls arrive one at a time for sharing around the courtyard table.

items.name: Mapo Tofu
items.description: Soft tofu settles into a red sauce of fermented chilli bean paste, minced beef and ground Sichuan pepper.

items.name: Silken Egg Drop Soup
items.description: Thin ribbons of egg drift through a clear, gently seasoned broth.

items.name: Sesame Cucumber Salad
items.description: Cool cucumber dressed with garlic, vinegar and a fragrant touch of sesame.

items.name: Ginger Beef Lo Mein
items.description: Wheat noodles, ginger and seared strips of beef meet in a glossy wok sauce.

items.name: Sichuan Braised Aubergine
items.description: Soft aubergine soaks up garlic, ginger and chilli bean sauce until the edges gleam.

items.name: Morning Chicken Congee
items.description: Rice simmered until silky, finished with shredded chicken and sliced spring onion.

venues.name: Anise & Steam
venues.description: A broth pot anchors this compact noodle room. A basket of herbs, a squeeze of citrus and the crunch of fresh vegetables finish the bowls at the table.

items.name: Star Anise Beef Pho
items.description: A clear beef broth scented with toasted star anise, ladled over rice noodles and thinly sliced beef.

items.name: Prawn Rice Paper Rolls
items.description: Tender prawns, herbs and crisp vegetables wrapped in translucent rice paper.

items.name: Caramel Claypot Trout
items.description: Trout glazed with a dark caramel sauce and scattered with spring onion.

items.name: Crispy Shallot Noodle Salad
items.description: Cool noodles and prawns meet fresh herbs and golden shallots in a sharp dressing.

items.name: Grilled Pork Vermicelli
items.description: Charred pork laid over fine vermicelli with herbs and a bright dipping sauce.

items.name: Ginger Sea Bass
items.description: Sea bass finished with a hot sizzle of ginger, spring onion and chilli.

venues.name: Sumac Ember
venues.description: A charcoal grill and a counter of cool meze share the room. Flatbreads arrive warm enough to soften the butter at their edges.

items.name: Adana Lamb Kebab
items.description: Minced lamb and red pepper shaped onto a skewer and grilled over charcoal.

items.name: Cacik with Fresh Mint
items.description: Cool strained yoghurt, grated cucumber and garlic, loosened with a little water and olive oil.

items.name: Ezme Pepper Salad
items.description: Tomato, red pepper and parsley chopped fine and sharpened with lemon.

items.name: Red Lentil Corba
items.description: A smooth red lentil soup finished with a little spiced oil and lemon at the table.

items.name: Walnut Date Cake
items.description: A honey-scented cake with pockets of soft date and toasted walnut.

items.name: Smoked Aubergine Purée
items.description: Flame-softened aubergine beaten smooth, its smoky sweetness lifted with lemon.

venues.name: Cumin & Copper
venues.description: A breakfast pot of fava beans gives way to layered rice and lentils at lunch in this imagined Cairo kitchen. Crisp onions are never far from the pass.

items.name: Cairo Koshari Bowl
items.description: Rice, lentils and pasta under a generous spoonful of tomato sauce and crisp fried onions.

items.name: Lemon Ful Medames
items.description: Slow-cooked fava beans mashed roughly with cumin, olive oil and lemon juice.

items.name: Herb Taamiya
items.description: Fava bean fritters with a green herb centre and a crisp, golden crust.

items.name: Garlic Mulukhiyah
items.description: Finely chopped molokhia leaves stirred into broth and finished with sizzling garlic and coriander.

items.name: Layered Egyptian Fatteh
items.description: Toasted bread and rice layered with beef, broth and a sharp garlic dressing.

items.name: Flaky Feteer
items.description: Paper-thin folds of buttery dough bake into a burnished pastry made for pulling apart.

venues.name: Lemon Quay
venues.description: Prawns, beans and lamb skewers share a short menu built for the middle of the table. Lemon is the finishing touch on almost every savoury plate.

items.name: Prawn Saganaki
items.description: Prawns simmer in tomato sauce with crumbled feta until the cheese softens at the edges.

items.name: Gigantes Plaki
items.description: Large white beans baked slowly in tomato, herbs and olive oil.

items.name: Lemon Lamb Souvlaki
items.description: Lemon-marinated lamb grilled on skewers and served straight from the coals.

items.name: Honey Yoghurt Cheesecake
items.description: A tangy yoghurt filling and crumbly base finished with a ribbon of honey.

items.name: Baked Aubergine Moussaka
items.description: Aubergine and spiced minced meat baked beneath a thick, golden béchamel.

items.name: Quinoa Market Salad
items.description: Quinoa tossed with tomato, cucumber and grilled chicken in a lemon dressing.

venues.name: Maíz de Patio
venues.description: A courtyard menu built for passing plates: warm tortillas, roasted peppers and a little citrus to wake everything up.

items.name: Griddled Fish Tacos
items.description: Flaky spiced fish tucked into tortillas with shredded cabbage and a squeeze of lime.

items.name: Black Bean Stuffed Peppers
items.description: Roasted bell peppers filled with black beans and quinoa, tender at the edges.

items.name: Braised Beef Chilli
items.description: Beef cooked slowly in a dark chilli sauce until tender enough to part with a spoon.

items.name: Sizzling Chickpea Fajitas
items.description: Peppers, onions and spiced chickpeas served hot with tortillas for folding.

items.name: Chicken Enchilada Bake
items.description: Layers of tortillas, shredded chicken and red sauce baked together until bubbling.

items.name: Dulce de Leche Cheesecake
items.description: Caramel-rich cheesecake over a crisp biscuit crust, served in a slender slice.

Breakfast: For the first table of the day: warm bowls, eggs, breads and fritters.
Noodles: Slurping encouraged: rice noodles, wheat noodles and brothy bowls.
Seafood: Fish and shellfish, from the steamer to the charcoal grill.
Soups: Clear broths, slow-simmered greens and warming ladlefuls.

cuisines.Thai: Tamarind, lime, fresh herbs and chilli meet in wok-fried noodles, broths and coconut curries.
cuisines.Chinese: Follow a Sichuan-focused selection of chilli-warmed tofu, wok-seared noodles and cooling vegetable plates.
cuisines.Vietnamese: A collection of aromatic broths, rice noodles and herb-filled rolls, from the breakfast bowl to the sharing plate.
cuisines.Turkish: Discover charcoal-grilled kebabs, peppery meze and lentil soups alongside warm bread.
cuisines.Egyptian: Fava beans, lentils and grains anchor a collection of breakfast pots, fritters and layered rice dishes.

maison-laurent.name: Chive Omelette
maison-laurent.description: A softly set omelette folded around chopped chives, with a supple centre.

bella-napoli.name: Prawn & Salmon Risotto
bella-napoli.description: Rice stirred slowly with stock, prawns and tender flakes of salmon.

sakura-house.name: Chicken Karaage
sakura-house.description: Marinated chicken pieces fried until the thin coating turns golden and craggy.

spice-garden.name: Golden Akara
spice-garden.description: Whipped black-eyed pea batter fried by the spoonful and served with pepper relish.

casa-verde.name: Pepper & Chickpea Fajitas
casa-verde.description: Hot strips of pepper and spiced chickpeas served with soft tortillas.

the-burger-house.name: New York Cheesecake
the-burger-house.description: A dense cream cheese filling baked on a crumb crust and served chilled.

saffron-room.name: Masala Bread Omelette
saffron-room.description: Eggs beaten with onion and chilli and folded around toasted bread.

olive-salt.name: Tomato-Baked Butter Beans
olive-salt.description: Large butter beans simmered with tomatoes and finished in the oven.

atelier-du-soir.name: Provençal Omelette Cake
atelier-du-soir.description: Thin layers of omelette and vegetables stacked into a savoury slice.

cortile-rosso.name: Tuscan Ribollita
cortile-rosso.description: Bread thickens this slow pot of beans, leafy greens and vegetables.

kumo-table.name: Wok-Seared Yaki Udon
kumo-table.description: Thick udon noodles tossed over high heat with vegetables and soy sauce.

ember-court.name: Spiced Plantain Rolls
ember-court.description: Sweet plantain wrapped around a savoury filling and browned at the edges.
